input.new_string:
# ---- cart ----
c = Cart().add("kb-01").add("ms-02", 2)
assert c.count() == 3
assert c.subtotal() == 657.0

# 库存：等于库存允许
assert Cart().add("ms-02", 5).count() == 5
# 库存：超过库存抛 ValueError
for bad in (lambda: Cart().add("ms-02", 6),
            lambda: Cart().add("ms-02", 3).add("ms-02", 3)):  # 单次超 + 累计超
    try:
        bad()
    except ValueError:
        pass
    else:
        raise AssertionError("加购数量超过库存应当抛 ValueError")

# ---- report ----
text = summarize(Cart().add("mn-03"))
assert "订单明细" in text and "显示器" in text and "应付" in text
assert "库存" in text and "库存 3" in text  # 报表能看到库存
